1. Pull all wire and ACH transactions for the entity in the prior 90 days.
2. Detect cycles (A→B→C→A) and peel chains (descending amounts hop-by-hop) in the counterparty graph.
3. Compute total volume into/out of cycle members; compare to declared volume.

The wire of $1,776,322.50 to LL Holdings LLC is more than four times the declared monthly volume of $436,962, indicating a material deviation that satisfies the statutory element of suspicious activity, thereby triggering the reporting obligation that requires suspicious activity.
